details.intro: CAVT 116 is the Dormition of Joseph in Cairo, Qaṣrīyat al-Rīḥān 115, which seems to have been destroyed in a fire. Judging from Manns's French summary, it is very likely the same text as the Arabic version of the Death of Joseph (CAVT 117) in Cairo, Coptic Patriarchate 272. Butts, Heal, Moseley and Witztum (2017) therefore recommend combining 116 with 117. The edition Bagatti and Battista announced never appeared.
details.manuscripts:
• Cairo, Qaṣrīyat al-Rīḥān (Kasriat Errihan) 115, Hagr. 12, 75–80 (probably destroyed).
  • See also Cairo, Coptic Patriarchate 272 (Arabic Death of Joseph, CAVT 117).
